thread:
Lara: FYI — customer VelvetHealth asked to onboard argus-28b for clinical summarization. SLA: p95 < 400ms, 10k reqs/day. Wants HIPAA via Private. Can we triage?
Adesh: @Lara noted. Is priority high? Any gold prompts/evals from them?
Lara: High. They provided 30 sample transcripts and a small evaluation rubric (sensitivity + hallucination metrics). Sending link: https://file.velvet/argus-eval
Liam: tagging infra. Argus-28b likely needs 80GB GPU if unquantized. Any quant targets? FP16 ok?
Sophia: We should try q4f16 and int8-ggml. First pass: FP16 baseline, then q4f16. If memory still high, try LLM.int8. Run quick quality check vs current prod model (redwood-7b-med).
Adesh: I'll queue a smoke run. Plan: (1) FP16 pack -> perf run (2) q4f16 -> reg-check on their rubric -> cost sim. Owners? @Liam infra for infra, @Sophia evals.
Liam: infra: can we allocate an 80GB A100 for 4 hours tomorrow? If private deployment need VPC prep + KMS. infra-bot will post resource link.
infra-bot: Resource request created: req-4792. ETA for GPU: 2026-02-12 09:00 UTC. KMS onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/kms-onboard
Sophia: For evals, give me the sample transcripts and target prompts. I'll run 3 eval passes: baseline, q4f16, int8. Expect ~6-8h total.
Lara: Customer expects canary next week. Also wants token-level cost estimate. Can we include batching suggestions?
Adesh: yes — will include batching policy (max 2048, dynamic batch up to 8) and KV caching notes. Will surface expected token cost after perf runs.
Liam: also flagging compatibility: argus uses FlashAttention2 kernels — ensure runtime build includes fa2. If not, fallback to nvfuser will be slower.
Sophia: Quick command I'll run:
```
python infra/eval/run_eval.py --model argus-28b --precision q4f16 --prompts eval_set.json --metrics hallucination,sensitivity --out results/q4f16.json
```
Adesh: Thanks. I'll create a checklist ticket and link here.
Lara: perfect — can we meet after smoke run to decide Dedicated vs Private? :eyes: 
Sophia: SG. I'll post results here. :thumbsup: 
Liam: noted. If infra still blocked ping me directly.
Adesh: ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RED-11234
Lara: Thanks team — assigning to owners: infra=@Liam, evals=@Sophia, intake=@Adesh. Closing loop when results posted.
(small reaction thread: :white_check_mark: from Lara, :rocket: from Sophia)
